body: As I stand there, watching my reflection slowly sway in the breeze like an old friend on the windowsill, both feelings tug at me simultaneously. The protective warmth sooths me as I imagine holding onto that image, while the pull of fascination compels me to draw closer, fingers tracing across the polished surface, searching for secrets hidden beneath. My gaze drifts over the familiar features, each line etched deeper than before, whispering stories of memories long forgotten or yet unsaid.
